# buildkite_pipelines (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve the pipelines of an organization, optionally filtered. You can find out more
about pipelines in the Buildkite [documentation](https://buildkite.com/docs/pipelines).

The pipelines are read with one paginated GraphQL query (500 per page), so use the filters on large organizations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# all unarchived pipelines in a cluster whose name matches "deploy"
data "buildkite_pipelines" "deploys" {
  cluster_id = buildkite_cluster.primary.id
  archived   = false
  search     = "deploy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Only return archived (`true`) or unarchived (`false`) pipelines. Both are returned when not set.
- `cluster_id` (String) Only return pipelines in the cluster with this GraphQL ID.
- `repository` (String) Only return pipelines with this repository URL.
- `search` (String) Only return pipelines whose name matches this search, case insensitively.
- `tags` (List of String) Only return pipelines that have these tags.

### Read-Only

- `pipelines` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pipelines))
- `total` (Number) The number of pipelines that match.

<a id="nestedatt--pipelines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pipelines`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline is archived.
- `cluster_id` (String) The GraphQL ID of the cluster the pipeline belongs to.
- `default_branch` (String) The default branch of the pipeline.
- `description` (String) The description of the pipeline.
- `id` (String) The GraphQL ID of the pipeline.
- `name` (String) The name of the pipeline.
- `repository` (String) The repository URL of the pipeline.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the pipeline.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the pipeline.
